description: Review eval: the AI review's own prompt and command line (scripts/lib/review-run.mjs) on small pull requests to page objects and components, each an isolated checkout of HEAD with the case's edits. 'files' are the pull request's changed files. A label anchors on a code snippet that occurs on exactly one line of the edited file. 'violations' must be flagged as must-fix or should-fix; 'exceptions' are correct code that looks wrong and must not be. Every planted change passes ESLint (npm run eval:review -- --check --lint): lint cannot see these, which is why the review exists.
